purpose: Request/access timing log used by the web/runtime layer.
cautions: Not a user activity feed; retention may be short and fields are technical.

purpose: Small system cache/mtime registry.
cautions: Never use as application data or durable state.

purpose: Last-change/index records used to detect modified objects and transactions.
cautions: Do not use as full audit history; it is an invalidation/change-detection structure.

purpose: Server-side user clipboard entries referencing arbitrary SObjects.
cautions: Do not duplicate object data; store only the reference and category.

purpose: Historical record of executed TACTIC commands.
cautions: Field name paramaters is legacy; do not build new business logic on it.

purpose: Generic directed relationship between two arbitrary SObjects with a context.
cautions: Never hand-insert without resolving source/destination identity; modern deployments may add search_code columns.

purpose: Project-local custom property definitions for a search type.
cautions: This does not itself add a physical DB column in every workflow; coordinate with search-type/schema tools.

purpose: Database connection resource used by projects/search types.
cautions: Contains credentials; never expose password to clients or logs.

purpose: Application debug log with category and level.
cautions: Not a durable activity/audit feed; can be retired/cleaned.

purpose: Simple department directory.
cautions: Keep code stable if referenced from login.department or custom logic.

purpose: Documentation alias/path registry.
cautions: Stores references/paths, not document file contents.

purpose: Unhandled/server exception records.
cautions: May contain stack traces and sensitive data; admin-only access and retention.

purpose: One tracked physical/logical file belonging to a snapshot.
cautions: Never insert file rows directly: naming, repository paths, snapshot XML, versionless files and triggers must stay consistent.

purpose: Audit of file access/download by login.
cautions: file_code is legacy-typed; do not repurpose as permissions.

purpose: Association between a notification definition and a login group.
cautions: This is configuration, not an inbox row.

purpose: Generic per-user interaction/state store keyed by a string.
cautions: Do not turn it into an unversioned dumping ground; namespace keys.

purpose: User/account record and profile.
cautions: Never write password directly; preserve external-auth/UPN/status semantics.

purpose: Security group with XML access_rules and project/default metadata.
cautions: Do not treat group name as authorization; effective access is computed by AccessManager.

purpose: Membership link between login and login_group.
cautions: Avoid duplicates; changes affect effective security and caches.

purpose: Message channel/container and latest/current message state; used for chat, sobject, script and progress categories.
cautions: A row is not necessarily one chat message. Do not use it as arbitrary notifications table.

purpose: Append-only message entries/history for a message channel.
cautions: Do not direct-insert: channel state, category, subscriptions and polling semantics can diverge.

purpose: Project milestone/due-date object.
cautions: Tasks reference milestone_code logically.

purpose: Comment/note attached polymorphically to any SObject, optionally by process/context and parent thread.
cautions: Do not create a parallel task_comments table; preserve access/private and parent_id semantics.

purpose: Notification definition/rule: event/listen_event, recipients, template and handler configuration.
cautions: Not a per-user inbox item. Do not insert one row per delivered notification.

purpose: Delivery/execution log for generated notifications.
cautions: Treat as audit/history; do not use as notification definition.

purpose: Per-login delivery association/status for a notification_log entry.
cautions: Not equivalent to chat read receipts.

purpose: Global/system pipeline XML and metadata; historically the primary Pipeline table.
cautions: Do not edit XML and related process rows independently; config/pipeline also exists in project DBs.

purpose: Definition/catalog of available preference keys and options.
cautions: Not the user value store; values belong in pref_setting.

purpose: Per-user/project preference key-value values.
cautions: Namespace keys; do not store security- or workflow-authoritative state.

purpose: Registered TACTIC project/template and its DB/naming/runtime metadata.
cautions: Creating a row alone does not create the project database, schema, config or permissions.

purpose: Project-type strategy class registry (naming, mapping, repository handlers).
cautions: Stores importable class names; invalid values can break project behavior.

purpose: Dispatcher/job queue record.
cautions: Do not insert jobs manually unless implementing the dispatcher contract including serialized command and state.

purpose: Legacy/optional remote repository endpoint mapping.
cautions: Do not confuse with sthpw/repo or modern repo definitions/configuration.

purpose: Legacy repository handler/path registry.
cautions: Repository configuration may also live outside this table; inspect deployment before relying on it.

purpose: Log of retired SObjects.
cautions: Do not use as the retired object itself or manually append.

purpose: XML project/data-model relationship schema.
cautions: Do not update independently of search types/physical columns; validate XML.

purpose: Search-type registry mapping logical search_type to DB/table/class/schema.
cautions: A row alone does not create/migrate the physical table or views; class_name is executable configuration.

purpose: Version/revision publication attached to an SObject; owns snapshot XML and file set.
cautions: Never direct-insert: version allocation, current/latest, files, naming, repository and triggers must be atomic.

purpose: Snapshot/check-in type configuration and optional pipeline/path flavor.
cautions: Legacy/optional in many projects; do not confuse snapshot_type with process/context.

purpose: Auxiliary indexed/list representation of SObject references and keywords.
cautions: Not a business collection or relation table.

purpose: Per-SObject index of actions linked to a transaction log.
cautions: Incomplete by design for some operations/large transactions; do not use as sole source of truth.

purpose: Calendar/work-schedule exception or special-day configuration.
cautions: Fields are legacy weekly/hour values; verify feature before extending.

purpose: Client-side event-to-callback trigger configuration.
cautions: Callback is executable client configuration; validate and restrict permissions.

purpose: Project custom script source and metadata.
cautions: Executable code: security-review, version and permission controls required.

purpose: Ingest rule definition tied to a session and base directory.
cautions: Rule/data formats are subsystem contracts; do not ad-hoc mutate.

purpose: Ingest session/configuration root.
cautions: Not a generic upload session unless ingest subsystem owns it.

purpose: Project naming rule for repository directories, files, sandbox and versionless behavior.
cautions: Avoid duplicate overlapping defaults; checkin_type/context/snapshot_type/condition determine selection.

purpose: Project-local pipeline XML/configuration.
cautions: Do not update XML without synchronizing config/process and workflow behavior.

purpose: Installed plugin manifest/version/location record.
cautions: A row alone does not install files, content or migrations.

purpose: Mapping of a plugin to content SObjects it installed/owns.
cautions: Do not manually delete before plugin uninstall/rollback logic.

purpose: Per-process configuration supplement for a pipeline node: check-in, contexts, repository and transfer behavior.
cautions: This is node configuration, not a task instance. Keep process+pipeline_code aligned with pipeline XML.

purpose: Runtime workflow state for one SObject/process.
cautions: Do not use as task status or UI cache; status/data are engine-owned JSON.

purpose: Project production/application setting catalog.
cautions: Keys may be cached and interpreted globally; avoid duplicates and arbitrary semantics.

purpose: Project-local translation table with language columns.
cautions: Schema is language-column based and may not scale to arbitrary locales without migration.

purpose: Project-local server trigger definition.
cautions: Executable class/script configuration; event/process/listen_process semantics must be validated.

purpose: Custom URL route to widget/configuration.
cautions: Widget content is executable UI configuration; restrict write permissions.

purpose: Project view/form/table/widget XML configuration.
cautions: Do not overwrite configs blindly: category/view/search_type/login precedence matters and XML must remain valid.

purpose: Append-only status transition history for an SObject, commonly task.
cautions: Do not update old rows or use as current status; current value lives on the target object/task.

purpose: User subscription/membership to a message channel with last-cleared read cursor.
cautions: Do not use as universal arbitrary subscription without message_code semantics; last_cleared is a watermark.

purpose: Outgoing/incoming remote synchronization job.
cautions: Command/data/state and transaction linkage are engine contracts.

purpose: Processed synchronization transaction/result log.
cautions: Do not retry by editing rows; use sync job/recovery APIs.

purpose: Remote TACTIC synchronization peer and credentials/rules.
cautions: Contains ticket/access rules and connectivity data; protect as secret config.

purpose: Concrete work item for one target SObject and process.
cautions: Do not create a parallel task table; preserve search target, process, pipeline, assignee and status triggers.

purpose: Authentication/session ticket with expiry/category.
cautions: Never mint or update tickets directly from clients.

purpose: Full transaction/command log including XML change payload and undo-related metadata.
cautions: Large/sensitive; do not mutate, and do not treat every row as user-facing activity.

purpose: Temporary XML-RPC/transaction state keyed by ticket.
cautions: Ephemeral internal state, not user settings.

purpose: Global locale msgid/msgstr translation records.
cautions: Do not mix with config/translation semantics without deciding global vs project scope.

purpose: Global/system trigger definition.
cautions: Prefer config/trigger for project-scoped behavior; executable configuration must be secured.

purpose: Watched folder configuration that launches a script/process for incoming files.
cautions: Do not treat as a generic filesystem bookmark; script and service lifecycle matter.

purpose: Persistent per-user widget state.
cautions: UI-only state; namespace keys and avoid authoritative business data.

purpose: Time/work-hour entry linked to an SObject/task/process.
cautions: Durations, dates and task linkage may drive reports/payroll; validate rather than ad-hoc insert.
